message.jaymospowers.web_symbiote.reflex: Air. Up. We have you. UP.
You are drowning. We will not let that happen.
Too long under. We are lifting you out.
Stone over us. We cannot lift you through it. Dig. Dig!
Roof. No way up. We are sorry. Dig!
We pushed. The stone did not move. You must.
Buried. We are tearing it away.
Earth in your mouth. Not today. Breaking it.
We will not be sealed in. Breaking out.
Cold, cold, cold. We are tearing the snow off you.
The white is eating your warmth. Out. OUT.
We hate this snow. We are pushing you free.
FIRE. We are throwing you to the shore. It will hurt us.
Not the fire. Never the fire. Heaving you out.
We burn, you burn. Shore. NOW.
No shore. Nothing to hold. Throwing you up anyway.
Fire all round. Up. UP.
We cannot reach stone. Climb, climb!
Back. There is nothing under that edge.
No. We are not falling today.
That drop kills. Back.
You are dying. We took the little gold idol from your bag.
Almost gone. We used your totem. Do not waste it.
We reached into your bag for the totem. You are welcome.
Almost gone. We took the golden apple from your bag and fed it to you.
Gold in your mouth. Swallow. We are not done with you.
You were nearly empty. We found the apple.
Poison. We took the milk from your bag. Drink.
The venom would have finished you. Milk. Now.
We poured it down you. Cleaner now.
Arrows. We turned them.
Our shell turns the little sticks.
Tick. Tick. Nothing gets through.
That one nearly went through. We took it on the shell. It cost us.
We caught the big one. We are hungrier for it.
It hit us, not you. We are tired now.
You forgot to eat. We ate for you.
You were starving and did not notice. We fed you.
Your belly was empty. We took bread from your bag.
Goodbye, little host. We were not meant to end this way.
Falling. Nothing under us. Goodbye.
The dark has no floor. Goodbye, warm one.
